_about: Structured self-introduction for KARTIK H. The narrative version is 00_ABOUT.md; this file is the same facts as parseable data. Confirmed by Kartik.
name: KARTIK H
headline: M.Pharm (Pharmacy Practice) scholar and builder, working on how healthcare knowledge becomes understanding, decisions, and better outcomes.
summary: Pharmacist by training, not a computer-science specialist. Directs AI models across the whole build lifecycle and owns the architecture around them. Work sits where pharmacy practice, health communication, and digital health meet.
central_question: How can healthcare knowledge be communicated, organised, and translated into understanding that helps people make better decisions, and ultimately improves health outcomes?

the_gap.capability_gap: Health systems produce enormous volumes of evidence-based material, which arrives as information overload rather than understanding.
the_gap.comprehension_gap: At the point of care, patients need immediate, simple, and culturally synchronised guidance to stay adherent and manage chronic conditions.
the_gap.working_hypothesis: Technology-assisted, vernacular, visual-first communication can measurably improve adherence and reduce avoidable re-hospitalisation.

education.institution: Satyam International School & PU College, Ballari

experience.notes: Built, alone, a learning ecosystem for pharmacy, nursing, and school-level students. Retired when it became too broad for one person to maintain responsibly.
One-time builds on the owner's own domain: landing page, WhatsApp contact, Google and maps presence, local-search basics.
Offline and online, as academic curriculum support.
Medical literature research, evidence synthesis, topic development, structured healthcare content planning.
Junior pharmacist across purchase, inventory, and clinical data management; master database of 750+ pharmaceutical products; MMU documentation aligned with NABH 6th Edition.
